description: Main window baseline plus the M3 IPC bridge commands, M4.1 session commands, and the Dashboard's health command. All network egress to the backend is Rust-mediated through these commands only — the webview itself is granted no http/websocket capability (phase3_desktop_architecture.md §11.1). `has-session`/`logout` never return or accept a token value — see `ipc.rs`. Phase A adds exactly two narrow, purpose-built exceptions to the prior 'no shell/filesystem permissions' baseline: `shell:allow-open` (launch the OS's default browser at a Google/Microsoft OAuth authorization URL only — never arbitrary shell execution, which this app still has no permission for) and `deep-link:default` (receive the `kortex-auth://` OAuth callback).
